commands: set -euo pipefail; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; echo BRANCH_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main); echo GIT_STATUS_BEGIN; git status --short; echo GIT_STATUS_END; MDNS="$("$ADB" mdns services 2>/dev/null || true)"; ENDPOINT="$(printf '%s\n' "$MDNS" | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; if [ -n "$ENDPOINT" ]; then "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null || true; TARGET="$ENDPOINT"; TRANSPORT=wifi; elif "$ADB" devices | awk '$1=="RFCT70L7E8J" && $2=="device" {found=1} END{exit !found}'; then TARGET=RFCT70L7E8J; TRANSPORT=usb; else echo NO_ADB_TARGET; "$ADB" devices -l; exit 2; fi; test "$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" get-state)" = device; echo ADB_TRANSPORT=$TRANSPORT; echo ADB_TARGET=$TARGET; echo DEVICE_MODEL=$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_SERIAL=$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r'); echo PACKAGE_INFO_BEGIN; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10 | tr -d '\r'; echo PACKAGE_INFO_END; echo PID=$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r' || true); echo DEVICES_BEGIN; "$ADB" devices -l; echo DEVICES_END
